domain_facts.statement: The owner runs a small bike repair workshop in Porto.
Customers book a repair slot in the app.
Customers see when their bike is ready.
Customers approve the quote and pay online.
The owner and the mechanic need a calendar of the day.
There are three kinds of users: customers, mechanics and the shop owner.
The workshop is in Porto, Portugal.
The app is shown in Portuguese (pt-PT) and English.
Customers pay the full repair online after the quote is approved.
No work starts on a bike before the customer approves the quote in the app.
A ready bike not collected after 14 days pays a storage fee of 2 euros a day.
Customers get a text message when the bike is ready to collect.
Invoices carry the shop's NIF and follow the Portuguese tax format.
The shop is open Monday to Saturday, 9:00 to 19:00.
The app takes card and MB WAY payments.
The bike sales catalogue can wait until a later version.
The first version is for repairs only.

card.question: What is the app for, in your own words?
card.why_we_ask: We need the core idea before we ask about details.

custom_input.placeholder: A booking app for my shop

card.intent: Capture the idea and the main jobs in the person's own words.
unlocks: The idea and the first feature list
card.answer_spec: What the app is for, who it serves and the main things it does.

qa.custom_text: I run a small bike repair workshop in Porto. Customers should be able to book a repair slot, see when their bike is ready, approve the quote and pay online. I also need a calendar so my mechanic and I can see the day.

card.question: Who will use the app?
card.why_we_ask: The roles decide who sees which screen.

options.label: Customers only
options.description: Only the people who bring bikes in

options.label: Customers, mechanics and the shop owner
options.description: Everyone in the shop uses the same app

options.label: Customers and the shop owner
options.description: Mechanics keep working from paper job sheets

card.intent: Find out which people use the app.
card.answer_spec: Who uses the app: customers, staff, owners.

card.question: Where is the workshop, and which languages should the app use?
card.why_we_ask: Place and language shape the research and the screens.
card.intent: Establish the place and the app languages.
card.answer_spec: City and country, and the languages the app should show.

qa.custom_text: The workshop is in Porto, Portugal. The app should be in Portuguese and English.

card.question: How should customers pay for a repair?
card.why_we_ask: The payment model decides the rules for the money.

options.label: Pay the full repair online
options.description: Paid in the app once the quote is approved

options.label: Pay a deposit to book, the rest at pickup
options.description: A small deposit holds the slot

options.label: Pay in the shop only
options.description: No payment in the app

card.intent: Decide how the shop earns money through the app.
card.answer_spec: When the customer pays and how much.

card.question: What has to happen before any work starts on a bike?
card.why_we_ask: This sets the order of the quote and the work.

options.label: Customer approves the quote in the app
options.description: The price is agreed before the bike is opened

options.label: The shop calls the customer to agree
options.description: A phone call agrees the price

options.label: Work starts and the price is added later
options.description: The bill is settled at pickup

card.intent: Find out who agrees the price before work starts.
card.answer_spec: Who must agree to the price and how.

card.question: Are there rules for bikes that are ready but not collected?
card.why_we_ask: Storage rules change what the status screen must show.

custom_input.placeholder: After how many days, and how much

card.intent: Find out whether late collection costs money.
card.answer_spec: When a bike counts as late and what it costs.

qa.custom_text: A bike that is ready but not collected after 14 days gets a storage fee of 2 euros a day.

card.question: How should customers hear that the bike is ready?
card.why_we_ask: The message must match what the status screen shows.

options.label: A text message
options.description: Sent to the phone number on the booking

options.label: An email
options.description: Sent to the email address on the booking

options.label: Both a text message and an email
options.description: Sent to both

card.intent: Pick the way the ready message reaches the customer.

card.question: Are there rules the shop must follow, such as invoices and opening hours?
card.why_we_ask: Compliance and hours limit what the app may show and promise.
card.intent: Find the invoice rules and the opening hours.
card.answer_spec: Mandatory invoice content and the opening hours.

qa.custom_text: Invoices need the shop's NIF and must follow the Portuguese tax format. The shop is open Monday to Saturday, 9:00 to 19:00.

card.question: Which payment methods should the app accept?
card.why_we_ask: The payment provider depends on the methods.

options.label: Card and MB WAY
options.description: Card payment and the MB WAY app

options.label: Card only
options.description: Card payment only

options.label: Cash at pickup only
options.description: No online payment

card.intent: Pick the payment methods for online payment.
card.answer_spec: Card, MB WAY, or cash only.

card.question: Is there anything to leave for later, so the first version stays small?
card.why_we_ask: A last check on what can wait.
card.intent: Find what the person is happy to leave for later.
card.answer_spec: Anything that can wait, and what the first version must do.

qa.custom_text: The bike sales catalogue can wait until later. Keep the first version to repairs.
